cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Let the Callback Claim Credit
cards.instruction: Get recognition by returning to an early overlooked contribution when its importance becomes undeniable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Remember my suggestion to put the spare key under the flowerpot?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. And now we're locked out beside a very useful flowerpot.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Say whose idea while you lift it. The pot can't accept all the credit.
